mara (DevEx): Heads up — the sample Next/Edge app started failing for a few customers after the recent package layout change. Repro steps below.

ben (SDK): ugh, which change? exports map tweak? :grimacing:

mara (DevEx): Yep. We removed `main` and relied on a conditional `exports` map pointing to `./dist/*`. Edge runtime (Next edge worker) seems to pick the wrong entry and TypeScript types vanish. Repro: `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/samples-next.git && cd samples-next && yarn && yarn dev` then open `/api/generate` — serverless edge throws `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` or runtime can't find types in editor.

sam (eng-runtime): Can you paste the exact error? Edge runtimes usually choke when they get CJS where ESM expected.

mara (DevEx): Screenshot pasted, but here's the stack snippet:

```
Error: SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'
 at new NodeError (internal/errors.js:xxx)
 at Module._compile (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:xxx)
 at Object.Module._extensions..js (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:xxx)
```

mara (DevEx): Also TS in the sample can't resolve types from the package, editor shows no intellisense — `types` subpath in exports isn't picked up by tsc.

katie (TS): Likely two separate issues: 1) runtime resolving to CJS bundle for edge, 2) types field/subpath missing or mis-declared. Can you paste package.json from the SDK version used in the sample?

mara (DevEx): Pasted minimal: 
```
{
  "name": "@redwood/sdk",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js"
    },
    "./client": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/client.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/client.js"
    }
  },
  "type": "module"
}
```

mara (DevEx): But Next edge is resolving `require` path somehow and trying to parse the cjs bundle as ESM. Also we didn't include a `types` entry anywhere (we ship types in `dist/types`), so editors using classic resolution fall back and can't find d.ts.

ben (SDK): Hmm. A couple of notes: Next's bundlers and edge lambdas use a mix of resolution strategies depending on whether they bundle or run raw. We probably need to add explicit subpath exports for `./package.json` and a `types` path. Also the `type: "module"` in package root plus `require` subpath can confuse some bundlers.

ben (SDK): Proposed minimal changes: add "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts" at top-level for TS fallback, and extend exports to include an "edge" subpath that points to an ESM-only minimal entry. Eg:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
    "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts"
  },
  "./edge": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/edge.js"
  }
}
```

jeff (support): We hit this in-prod with a customer on Vercel — their edge functions started 500ing after upgrading the SDK. We shipped a workaround in their monorepo by pinning `@redwood/sdk@1.1.7` and adding a webpack alias to force the `esm` build. Not ideal.

katie (TS): For types: tsc uses `types` or `typings` at package root, not the `types` conditional inside `exports`. Some editors use `exports`-aware resolution but older flows do not. Add `types` field at root. Also ensure `typesVersions` if we need subpath aliasing.

sam (eng-runtime): Quick runtime mitigation: if we publish `./dist/esm/edge.js` that is ESM-only and consumers can import `@redwood/sdk/edge` in edge runtimes, they can avoid accidental require resolution. But that's a breaking API unless we keep `./edge` as optional.

mara (DevEx): Can someone make a tiny repro branch and a PR? I'll add a note to the onboarding docs to recommend `@redwood/sdk/edge` for edge pages until we fix. Customers already tripping over this — want a quick patch.

ben (SDK): I'll open a PR with the following changes: add root `types`, add `./edge` export, and tweak default `.` export to prefer `import` over `require` for ESM-first consumers. Will also add tests that run the Next sample against a bundler step in CI. Link once ready.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch `fix/exports-edge-types` — build started :rocket:

ben (SDK): PR opened: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234|#1234> — includes changelog and sample update.

mara (DevEx): Nice. Can we also add a one-liner in the sample readme (migration note) explaining the `edge` import and how to pin if needed? I'll coordinate docs update.

jeff (support): After PR lands, I'll reach out to affected customers and ask them to test the patch release.

katie (TS): One more ask: run `tsc --build` in the sample in CI with `NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=import` to simulate ESM-first consumers. I'll add that to the PR CI matrix.

sam (eng-runtime): Also add a tiny runtime test that exercises an edge worker import path so we catch regressions earlier.

mara (DevEx): Thanks all — I'll keep the thread updated with customer feedback. :thumbsup:
